chunks: Nothing more than the speech of a man!
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says 'This is not the speech of a man'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Muddaththir, this verse serves as a divine rebuttal to the Quraysh's claim that Muhammad (peace be upon him) was merely reciting poetry or human wisdom, thereby affirming the supernatural origin of the revelation. Shia scholarship emphasizes this distinction to validate the Prophet's unique status as the recipient of divine speech (Kalam Allah), contrasting it with the ephemeral nature of human discourse.
